correctness.rationale: For Q(x,y)=x·y, the normalized Fourier coefficient of 1_X follows by additive orthogonality: F(0)=1/q+(q-1)/q^(m+1), F(ξ,η)=b if nonzero and ξ·η=0, and -q^(-m-1) otherwise. Therefore on the coordinate-character set E the Gram matrix is a I+b J-c A, with A the m disjoint K_(q-1,q-1) bipartite pair graphs and an isolated zero frequency. Block contrasts (dimension 2m(q-2)), antisymmetric pairs (m), symmetric pair contrasts (m-1), plus the 2x2 block exhaust 1+2m(q-1); their eigenvalues and equality spaces follow. Exact numerical checks across q=3,5,7,9,11 and m=2..10 corroborated strict ordering, but field-wide result rests on exact character sums valid for all odd prime powers. At m=1 equality dimension two and min q^-2 as stated.
